sqlquery.from:
(
with temp as (select p.id, p.name, coalesce(sum(tsh.timespent), 0) timespent from "$".project p left join "$".timesheet tsh on tsh.projectid = p.id left join "$".reference r on r.id = p.statusid,
(select max(x) has from (select case r.code in ('ADMIN','DR') when true then 1 else 0 end x from "$".myuser_role ur join "$".role r on ur.roles_id=r.id where ur.users_id = #?user_id?# ) a) isAdmin
,(select te.teamid from "$".teamemployee te where te.employeeid = #?user_id?# and te.isdeleted is not true) teamleader
where r.code not in ('PS_NOT_STARTED' ,'PS_COMPLETED') and p.isdeleted is not true and ( isAdmin.has = 1 or (tsh.teamid = teamleader.teamid)) and (tsh.date between currentyearfirstday() and currenttimstamp()) group by p.id, p.name order by timespent desc)
select t.id, t.name projectname, cast(to_char((t.timespent * 100) / timesheet.total, '990.99') as float) timeSheet from temp t join (select sum(t.timespent) total from temp t) timesheet on 1=1
)t
